\section*{How to use this dictionary}
Keep it open next to the manual (\href{simplydata_manual.pdf}{\code{simplydata\_\allowbreak{}manual.\allowbreak{}pdf}}). The first pages,
\hyperref[glance]{\textbf{All the words at a glance}}, show every word group by group, one line
each; the entries A to Z after them explain each word in full.
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.6em]
  \item \textbf{Look up a word.} The words are in A to Z order. The words at the top of each page
    are the first and the last word on that page, as in a printed dictionary.
  \item \textbf{Read what it means.} One line says what the word does, in the words of
    \code{sdata.help("word")}.
  \item \textbf{Try the example.} Every example runs as written. Most use a practice table, named
    in brackets after the example: \code{(marks)} means
    \code{table = sdata.table(sdata.get\_example("marks"))} for a table word, or
    \code{chart = sdata.chart(sdata.get\_example("marks"))} for a chart word.
  \item \textbf{See what runs underneath.} \textbf{Underneath} names the package that does the work
    (pandas, Polars, NumPy, seaborn, SciPy, R ...). Where the manual has a grey box ``The same
    underneath'', the line is read from its tested code, and the box shows the full code.
  \item \textbf{Read the page.} \textbf{Manual p.} gives the page of the manual where the word is
    explained in full; the number is a link that opens the manual at that page. \textbf{Lesson}
    gives the lessons that teach it.
\end{enumerate}
Some words belong to more than one thing: \code{save} saves a chart, a table or numbers. Then
the word has one entry with a part for each, marked
\kind{chart}, \kind{table}, \kind{numbers} and so on:
\begin{center}\small
\begin{tabular}{@{}ll@{}}
\kind{sdata} \code{sdata.chart(...)} & called on simplydata itself\\
\kind{table} \code{table.keep\_rows\_where(...)} & a step on a table\\
\kind{chart} \code{chart.draw\_bars(...)} & a step on a chart\\
\kind{option} \code{show="median"} & an option inside a chart step\\
\kind{numbers} \code{numbers.find\_average()} & a step on numbers: \code{numbers = sdata.number\_list([12, 15, 9])}\\
\kind{grid} \code{grid.get\_row(1)} & a step on a grid: \code{grid = sdata.number\_grid([[3, 5], [8, 6]])}\\
\kind{distribution} \code{distribution.find\_chance\_that\_value(is\_above=60)} & a step on a distribution: \code{distribution = sdata.distribution("normal")}\\
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
Know the name from pandas, R, NumPy or matplotlib (\code{groupby}, \code{iloc}, \code{hist},
\code{curve\_fit})? Look it up in \hyperref[other:names]{\textbf{Coming from another tool?}} at the end.

\section*{How the words are built}
A line of simplydata reads like an instruction you say to the program: the thing, then what it
should do, then the details: \code{table.keep\_rows\_where("marks", is\_above=50)},
\code{chart.draw\_bars(x="class", y="marks")}.
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.2em]
  \item \textbf{A word starts with what it does, in full English words}: \code{keep\_rows\_where},
    \code{find\_average\_of}, \code{draw\_bars}, \code{write\_title\_on\_top}. No short forms to remember.
  \item \textbf{Words come in families.} Learn \code{keep\_rows\_where} and you can guess
    \code{keep\_columns}, \code{keep\_each\_number\_that} and \code{keep\_first\_rows}. \hyperref[families]{Word families}
    lists them.
  \item \textbf{A small word joins the first input}: \code{keep\_rows\_where("marks", ...)},
    \code{fill\_empty\_cells\_in("price", ...)}, \code{find\_average\_of("marks")}.
  \item \textbf{Anything for one axis ends in \code{\_x} or \code{\_y}}: \code{label\_y},
    \code{set\_range\_x}, \code{use\_log\_scale\_y}. x goes across, y goes up.
  \item \textbf{One option name means one thing everywhere}: \code{for\_each\_group\_in=} (a result for each
    group of a table), \code{in\_each="row"} (a result for each row of a grid), conditions start with \code{is\_} (\code{is\_above=}, \code{is\_between=[low, high]}),
    \code{colour=}, \code{from\_column=}.
  \item \textbf{Counting starts at 1}, as people count: \code{numbers.get\_number\_at(1)} is the first number,
    \code{grid.get\_row(1)} the top row.
  \item \textbf{Every change can be taken back} with \code{undo()}.
\end{itemize}

\clearpage\section*{All the words at a glance}\label{glance}\markboth{At a glance}{At a glance}
Every word, group by group, in the order \code{sdata.show\_all\_words()} prints them. Table words
are steps on a table, for looking at data, cleaning it and summing it up; chart words are steps on
a chart; number words are steps on a list (or a grid) of numbers:
{\footnotesize\begin{verbatim}
import simplydata as sdata
table = sdata.table(sdata.get_example("marks"))   # or sdata.table("my_file.xlsx")
table.keep_rows_where("marks", is_above=50)
table.find_average_of("marks", for_each_group_in="class")   # says the answer in a sentence
table.save("good_marks.xlsx")
chart = table.start_chart()             # or sdata.chart(table), sdata.chart("my_file.xlsx")
chart.draw_bars(x="class", y="marks", error="standard error")
chart.write_title_on_top("Good marks")
chart.save("marks.png")
numbers = sdata.number_list([12, 15, 9, 20, 14])
bigger = numbers * 2                       # symbols make new numbers
numbers.keep_each_number_that(is_above=10) # words change the numbers (undo() takes it back)
numbers.find_average()
grid = sdata.number_grid([[3, 5, 2], [8, 6, 4]])
\end{verbatim}}
Every example runs as written on the practice table in brackets after it: \code{(weather)} means
\code{weather = sdata.get\_example("weather")}, then \code{chart = sdata.chart(weather)} for a chart
word or \code{table = sdata.table(weather)} for a table word. Number words use
\code{numbers = sdata.number\_list([12, 15, 9, 20, 14])}, grid words
\code{grid = sdata.number\_grid([[3, 5, 2], [8, 6, 4]])} and system words
\code{system = sdata.system("1 / (s**2 + 2*s + 5)")}. Steps such as \code{fit\_line} or
\code{write\_title\_on\_top} go after a chart step such as \code{chart.draw\_dots(...)}, and \code{a},
\code{b} in \code{sdata.put\_side\_by\_side(a, b)} are charts you made first. Each word is a link to its
entry, and \code{sdata.help("word")} shows its example ready to run.

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:look-from]{\code{look\_\allowbreak{}from}} {\color{inkgrey}(also \code{view\_\allowbreak{}from})}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}look\_\allowbreak{}from(height=20,\allowbreak{} around=45)}}{The angle a 3D chart is seen from.}
\glancegroup{Describing a chart}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:say-what-it-shows]{\code{say\_\allowbreak{}what\_\allowbreak{}it\_\allowbreak{}shows}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}say\_\allowbreak{}what\_\allowbreak{}it\_\allowbreak{}shows()}}{Say in words what the chart shows, for a caption or for readers who cannot see it.}
\glancegroup{Web pages}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-in-web-page]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}in\_\allowbreak{}web\_\allowbreak{}page}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}in\_\allowbreak{}web\_\allowbreak{}page()}}{Show the chart as a web page: point at marks to read them, zoom, click the legend.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-when-pointing]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}when\_\allowbreak{}pointing}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}when\_\allowbreak{}pointing(\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}class\textquotedbl{})}}{The columns shown when the pointer rests on a dot or a line in a web page.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-range-bar-x]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}range\_\allowbreak{}bar\_\allowbreak{}x}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}range\_\allowbreak{}bar\_\allowbreak{}x()}}{A small bar under the x-axis of a web page, to choose the part of the x-axis shown.}
\glancegroup{Breaks and other scales}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:break-between-y]{\code{break\_\allowbreak{}between\_\allowbreak{}y}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}break\_\allowbreak{}between\_\allowbreak{}y(5,\allowbreak{} 50)}}{Leave out the part of the y-axis between two values, with break marks.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:use-scale-x]{\code{use\_\allowbreak{}scale\_\allowbreak{}x}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}use\_\allowbreak{}scale\_\allowbreak{}x(\textquotedbl{}square root\textquotedbl{})}}{Another scale on the x-axis: \code{\textquotedbl{}square root\textquotedbl{}}, \code{\textquotedbl{}logit\textquotedbl{}} or \code{\textquotedbl{}asinh\textquotedbl{}}.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:use-scale-y]{\code{use\_\allowbreak{}scale\_\allowbreak{}y}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}use\_\allowbreak{}scale\_\allowbreak{}y(\textquotedbl{}square root\textquotedbl{})}}{Another scale on the y-axis: \code{\textquotedbl{}square root\textquotedbl{}}, \code{\textquotedbl{}logit\textquotedbl{}} or \code{\textquotedbl{}asinh\textquotedbl{}}.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:use-background-colour]{\code{use\_\allowbreak{}background\_\allowbreak{}colour}} {\color{inkgrey}(also \code{use\_\allowbreak{}background\_\allowbreak{}color})}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}use\_\allowbreak{}background\_\allowbreak{}colour(\textquotedbl{}ivory\textquotedbl{})}}{The colour behind the plot area.}
\glancegroup{More marks}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-hexagon-bins]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}hexagon\_\allowbreak{}bins}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}hexagon\_\allowbreak{}bins(x=\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}height\textquotedbl{})}}{Many dots counted in hexagons: the darker, the more dots.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-time-bars]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}time\_\allowbreak{}bars}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}time\_\allowbreak{}bars(start=[1,\allowbreak{} 3,\allowbreak{} 6],\allowbreak{} end=[4,\allowbreak{} 7,\allowbreak{} 9],\allowbreak{} y=[\textquotedbl{}plan\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}build\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}test\textquotedbl{}])}}{A bar from a start to an end on each row, as in a plan or a timeline.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-circle]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}circle}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}circle(centre=[5,\allowbreak{} 70],\allowbreak{} radius=1)}}{A circle on the chart, to mark a place.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-residual-dots]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}residual\_\allowbreak{}dots}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}residual\_\allowbreak{}dots(x=\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{})}}{What is left of y after a straight line on x, as dots round a line at 0.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-event-lines]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}event\_\allowbreak{}lines}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}event\_\allowbreak{}lines(x=\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}class\textquotedbl{})}}{A short upright line at each value, so every time something happened shows.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-bars-3d]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}bars\_\allowbreak{}3d}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}bars\_\allowbreak{}3d(x=\textquotedbl{}month\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}city\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} z=\textquotedbl{}rain\textquotedbl{})}}{Bars standing in a 3D box: one bar for each row, as high as z.}
\glancegroup{Tables: start and look}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:table]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}table}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}table(sdata.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}example(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{}))}}{Start a table.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-first-rows]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}first\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}first\_\allowbreak{}rows(5)}}{Show the first rows, numbered from 1.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-last-rows]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}rows(5)}}{Show the last rows, with their row numbers in the whole table.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show]{\code{show}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show()}}{Show the table, every row and every column (or only the first \code{rows=}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-column-names]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}column\_\allowbreak{}names}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}column\_\allowbreak{}names()}}{The names of all columns.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:describe-columns]{\code{describe\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}describe\_\allowbreak{}columns()}}{Describe every column: its kind, empty cells, smallest, biggest and average.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-column]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}column}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}column(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{})}}{One column on its own: a column of numbers becomes \code{sdata.\allowbreak{}number\_\allowbreak{}list}, any other a plain list.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-row]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}row}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}row(3)}}{One row as a plain dict of column: value, counting from 1.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-cell-at]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}cell\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}cell\_\allowbreak{}at(row=3,\allowbreak{} column=\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{})}}{The value in one cell: a row counting from 1 and a column by name.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:count-columns]{\code{count\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}count\_\allowbreak{}columns()}}{How many columns the table has (\code{count\_\allowbreak{}rows()} gives the rows).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-differences-from]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}differences\_\allowbreak{}from}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}differences\_\allowbreak{}from(sdata.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}example(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{}))}}{Show the cells that differ between this table and another one, as row, column, this, other.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:check-if-same-as]{\code{check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}same\_\allowbreak{}as}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}same\_\allowbreak{}as(sdata.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}example(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{}))}}{Check whether this table and another one are the same: it says so, or names the first difference.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:check-if-all-values-in]{\code{check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} is\_\allowbreak{}above=0)}}{Check whether every value of a column meets a condition.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:check-if-any-value-in]{\code{check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}any\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}any\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} is\_\allowbreak{}above=90)}}{Check whether any value of a column meets a condition.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:check-if-sorted-by]{\code{check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}sorted\_\allowbreak{}by}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}check\_\allowbreak{}if\_\allowbreak{}sorted\_\allowbreak{}by(\textquotedbl{}month\_\allowbreak{}number\textquotedbl{})}}{Check whether the rows are in order of a column, smallest first.}
\glancegroup{Choose columns}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-columns]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}columns(\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{})}}{Keep only these columns: by name (in the order you list them), a run of names, or by kind.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-columns]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}columns(\textquotedbl{}height\textquotedbl{})}}{Remove these columns: by name, a run of names, or by kind.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-columns-by-position]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position(1,\allowbreak{} to=3)}}{Keep columns by their position, counting from 1 at the left; it says which columns they were.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-columns-by-position]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position(1)}}{Remove columns by their position, counting from 1 at the left; it says which columns they were.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:rename-column]{\code{rename\_\allowbreak{}column}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}rename\_\allowbreak{}column(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} to=\textquotedbl{}score\textquotedbl{})}}{Give a column a new name.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:clean-column-names]{\code{clean\_\allowbreak{}column\_\allowbreak{}names}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}clean\_\allowbreak{}column\_\allowbreak{}names()}}{Make every column name plain: small letters, no spaces or signs, words joined by \code{\textquotedbl{}\_\allowbreak{}\textquotedbl{}}.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:rename-columns]{\code{rename\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}rename\_\allowbreak{}columns(\{\textquotedbl{}temperature\textquotedbl{}: \textquotedbl{}temp\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}rain\textquotedbl{}: \textquotedbl{}rain\_\allowbreak{}mm\textquotedbl{}\})}}{Give several columns new names at once, or add the same text in front of (or after) every name.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:move-columns]{\code{move\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}move\_\allowbreak{}columns(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} to=\textquotedbl{}start\textquotedbl{})}}{Move columns to the start or the end of the table, or after another column.}
\glancegroup{Choose rows}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-rows-where]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}where}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}where(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} is\_\allowbreak{}above=50)}}{Keep only the rows that match a condition.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-rows-where]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}where}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}where(\textquotedbl{}subject\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} is\_\allowbreak{}equal\_\allowbreak{}to=\textquotedbl{}English\textquotedbl{})}}{Remove the rows that match a condition (the opposite of \code{keep\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}where}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-first-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}first\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}first\_\allowbreak{}rows(10)}}{Keep only the first rows, of the whole table or of each group.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-last-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}rows(10)}}{Keep only the last rows, of the whole table or of each group.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-rows-by-position]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position(10,\allowbreak{} to=20)}}{Keep rows by their position, counting from 1: a run, every n-th row, or a list.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-rows-by-position]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position([12,\allowbreak{} 40])}}{Remove rows by their position, counting from 1: a run, every n-th row, or a list.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:reverse-rows]{\code{reverse\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}reverse\_\allowbreak{}rows()}}{Turn the table upside down: the last row comes first.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-random-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}random\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}random\_\allowbreak{}rows(10,\allowbreak{} with\_\allowbreak{}seed=1)}}{Keep some rows picked at random; give a seed to get the same rows every time.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-duplicate-rows]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}duplicate\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}duplicate\_\allowbreak{}rows(columns=[\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{}])}}{Remove rows that repeat an earlier row, or that repeat it in the columns you name.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:repeat-each-row-by]{\code{repeat\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}row\_\allowbreak{}by}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}repeat\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}row\_\allowbreak{}by(\textquotedbl{}count\textquotedbl{})}}{Repeat each row as many times as the count in a column: one row per thing counted.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-biggest-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}biggest\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}biggest\_\allowbreak{}rows(3,\allowbreak{} by=\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}subject\textquotedbl{})}}{Keep the n rows with the biggest values in a column (also for each group).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-smallest-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}smallest\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}smallest\_\allowbreak{}rows(3,\allowbreak{} by=\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}subject\textquotedbl{})}}{Keep the n rows with the smallest values in a column (also for each group).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-rows-with-outliers]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}outliers}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}outliers(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}subject\textquotedbl{})}}{Show the rows whose value in a column is an outlier, and say why (the table does not change).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-rows-with-outliers]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}outliers}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}outliers(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}subject\textquotedbl{})}}{Remove the rows whose value in a column is an outlier, and say how many and why.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-duplicate-rows]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}duplicate\_\allowbreak{}rows}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}duplicate\_\allowbreak{}rows()}}{Show the rows that repeat another row, each with its row number (the table does not change).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-groups-where]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}groups\_\allowbreak{}where}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}groups\_\allowbreak{}where(\textquotedbl{}average(marks) \textgreater{}= 50\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}school\textquotedbl{})}}{Keep only the whole groups that meet a condition on a summary of the group.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-groups-where]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}groups\_\allowbreak{}where}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}groups\_\allowbreak{}where(\textquotedbl{}average(marks) \textless{} 50\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}school\textquotedbl{})}}{Remove the whole groups that meet a condition on a summary of the group (the opposite of \code{keep\_\allowbreak{}groups\_\allowbreak{}where}).}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-rows-that-are-all-empty]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}are\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}empty}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}are\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}empty()}}{Remove the rows in which every cell is empty, as a spreadsheet leaves between blocks of data.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-columns-that-are-all-empty]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}are\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}empty}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}are\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}empty()}}{Remove the columns in which every cell is empty, such as a column nobody filled in.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:fill-empty-cells-from]{\code{fill\_\allowbreak{}empty\_\allowbreak{}cells\_\allowbreak{}from}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}fill\_\allowbreak{}empty\_\allowbreak{}cells\_\allowbreak{}from(\{\textquotedbl{}sample\_\allowbreak{}id\textquotedbl{}: [1,\allowbreak{} 2,\allowbreak{} 12],\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}notes\textquotedbl{}: [\textquotedbl{}calm\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}calm\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}rain\textquotedbl{}]\},\allowbreak{} using=\textquotedbl{}sample\_\allowbreak{}id\textquotedbl{})}}{Fill the empty cells of this table from the matching rows of another table; filled cells never change.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-rows-with-empty-cells-in]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}empty\_\allowbreak{}cells\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}rows\_\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}empty\_\allowbreak{}cells\_\allowbreak{}in()}}{Show the rows that have an empty cell, each with its row number (the table does not change).}
\glancegroup{Fix columns}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-numbers]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}numbers}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}numbers(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{})}}{Turn a column into numbers; cells that are not numbers become empty.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-text]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}text}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}text(\textquotedbl{}month\_\allowbreak{}number\textquotedbl{})}}{Turn a column into text.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-dates]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}dates}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}dates(\textquotedbl{}year\textquotedbl{})}}{Turn a column into dates; cells that are not dates become empty.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-lowercase]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}lowercase}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}lowercase(\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{})}}{Write all the text in a column in small letters.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-uppercase]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}uppercase}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}uppercase(\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{})}}{Write all the text in a column in capital letters.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-extra-spaces-in]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}extra\_\allowbreak{}spaces\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}extra\_\allowbreak{}spaces\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{})}}{Remove spaces at the start and end of the text, and double spaces inside it.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:replace-values-in]{\code{replace\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}replace\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}subject\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}Maths\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} with\_\allowbreak{}value=\textquotedbl{}Math\textquotedbl{})}}{Replace a value (or a list of values) in a column; \code{with\_\allowbreak{}value=None} makes those cells empty.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:round-numbers-in]{\code{round\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}round\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} 0)}}{Round numbers to this many decimal places: in one column, a list of columns, or every number column.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:change-column]{\code{change\_\allowbreak{}column}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}column(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}marks / 10\textquotedbl{})}}{Change the values of a column in place, with the same ways as \code{add\_\allowbreak{}column()}.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-categories]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}categories}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}categories(\textquotedbl{}nurse\_\allowbreak{}rating\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} in\_\allowbreak{}order=[\textquotedbl{}mild\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}moderate\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}severe\textquotedbl{}])}}{Turn a text column into categories: a fixed list of values, in an order you give.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-title-case]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}title\_\allowbreak{}case}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}title\_\allowbreak{}case(\textquotedbl{}name\textquotedbl{})}}{Start each word with a capital letter (\code{\textquotedbl{}asha ali\textquotedbl{}} becomes \code{\textquotedbl{}Asha Ali\textquotedbl{}}).}
\glancegroup{Sort and new columns}

\textquotedbl{}married\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}nodegree\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}re74\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}re75\textquotedbl{}])}}{Make two groups alike in other columns, then compare them (propensity scores, weighting, matching).}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:compare-to-truth]{\code{compare\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}truth}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}compare\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}truth(\textquotedbl{}rapid\_\allowbreak{}test\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} truth=\textquotedbl{}infected\textquotedbl{})}}{How well does a test find what is really there (sensitivity, specificity, predictive values)?}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:compare-accuracy]{\code{compare\_\allowbreak{}accuracy}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}compare\_\allowbreak{}accuracy(\textquotedbl{}crp\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}procalcitonin\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} truth=\textquotedbl{}infected\textquotedbl{})}}{Which of two scores tells better who has it? DeLong's test of two AUCs on the same rows.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:compare-to-truth]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}compare\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}truth}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}compare\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}truth(found=45,\allowbreak{} missed=5,\allowbreak{} false\_\allowbreak{}alarms=30,\allowbreak{} correct\_\allowbreak{}negatives=920)}}{How well does a test find what is really there? From the four counts, or from percents.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-trade-off-curve]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}trade\_\allowbreak{}off\_\allowbreak{}curve}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}trade\_\allowbreak{}off\_\allowbreak{}curve(score=\textquotedbl{}crp\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} truth=\textquotedbl{}infected\textquotedbl{})}}{How a score trades found cases against false alarms, cut-off by cut-off (the ROC curve).}
\glancegroup{Agreement and reliability}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:agreement-between]{\code{agreement\_\allowbreak{}between}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}agreement\_\allowbreak{}between(\textquotedbl{}nurse\_\allowbreak{}rating\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}doctor\_\allowbreak{}rating\textquotedbl{})}}{How well do two or more raters (or devices) agree on the same rows?}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:limits-of-agreement]{\code{limits\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}agreement}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}limits\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}agreement(\textquotedbl{}device\_\allowbreak{}a\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}device\_\allowbreak{}b\textquotedbl{})}}{How far apart are two ways of measuring the same thing (Bland-Altman limits of agreement)?}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:reliability-of]{\code{reliability\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}reliability\_\allowbreak{}of([\textquotedbl{}item\_\allowbreak{}1\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}item\_\allowbreak{}2\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}item\_\allowbreak{}3\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}item\_\allowbreak{}4\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}item\_\allowbreak{}5\textquotedbl{}])}}{Do the items of a questionnaire hang together (Cronbach's alpha)?}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:draw-difference-dots]{\code{draw\_\allowbreak{}difference\_\allowbreak{}dots}}}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}draw\_\allowbreak{}difference\_\allowbreak{}dots(first=\textquotedbl{}device\_\allowbreak{}a\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} second=\textquotedbl{}device\_\allowbreak{}b\textquotedbl{})}}{Do two ways of measuring agree? The difference of each pair against its average (Bland-Altman).}
\glancegroup{Fitting}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:fit-line]{\code{fit\_\allowbreak{}line}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}fit\_\allowbreak{}line(x=\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{})}}{Fit the straight line y = slope * x + intercept that best follows the points.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:fit-curve]{\code{fit\_\allowbreak{}curve}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}fit\_\allowbreak{}curve(x=\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} of\_\allowbreak{}degree=2)}}{Fit a curve y = b0 + b1 * x + b2 * x**2 ... that best follows the points.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:fit-dose-response]{\code{fit\_\allowbreak{}dose\_\allowbreak{}response}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}fit\_\allowbreak{}dose\_\allowbreak{}response(x=\textquotedbl{}concentration\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} y=\textquotedbl{}root\_\allowbreak{}length\textquotedbl{})}}{Fit a dose-response curve and find the dose for 50 \% of the effect (ED50, EC50, LD50).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-best-power-of]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}best\_\allowbreak{}power\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}best\_\allowbreak{}power\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}days\textquotedbl{})}}{Find the power to raise a column to that brings it closest to a normal shape (Box-Cox).}
\glancegroup{Finding and solving}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-where-smallest]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}smallest}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}smallest(\textquotedbl{}x**2 - 4*x + 1\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} between=[0,\allowbreak{} 5])}}{Find where a formula is smallest, and its value there.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-where-biggest]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}biggest}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}biggest(\textquotedbl{}3*x + 2*y\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} rules=[\textquotedbl{}x + y \textless{}= 4\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}x + 3*y \textless{}= 6\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}x \textgreater{}= 0\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}y \textgreater{}= 0\textquotedbl{}])}}{Find where a formula is biggest, and its value there.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:solve]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}solve}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}solve(\textquotedbl{}x**3 - 2*x = 5\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} between=[0,\allowbreak{} 3])}}{Find the values that make an equation true.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-sensitivity-of]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}sensitivity\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}sensitivity\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}a + b\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} ranges=\{\textquotedbl{}a\textquotedbl{}: [0,\allowbreak{} 1],\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}b\textquotedbl{}: [0,\allowbreak{} 5]\})}}{Which input matters most.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-best-pairing]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}best\_\allowbreak{}pairing}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}best\_\allowbreak{}pairing([[4,\allowbreak{} 1],\allowbreak{} [2,\allowbreak{} 3]])}}{Pair each row with one column for the smallest total.}
\glancegroup{Formulas and exact answers}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:formula]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}formula}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}formula(\textquotedbl{}(x + 2)**2 - 4\textquotedbl{})}}{A formula to work with exactly (SymPy): simpler, multiplied out, slopes, areas, limits.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:make-simpler]{\code{make\_\allowbreak{}simpler}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}simpler()}}{Write the formula in a simpler way (SymPy simplify).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-sum]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}sum}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}sum()}}{Multiply out the brackets, so the formula is a sum of terms (SymPy expand).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-product]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}product}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}product()}}{Write the formula as a product of factors (SymPy factor).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-slope-formula]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}slope\_\allowbreak{}formula}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}slope\_\allowbreak{}formula()}}{The formula of the slope (the derivative), as a new formula.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-area-formula]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}area\_\allowbreak{}formula}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}area\_\allowbreak{}formula()}}{The formula of the area under the curve (the integral), as a new formula.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-value-at]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}at(x=2)}}{The value of the formula when each letter has a value.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:put-in]{\code{put\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}put\_\allowbreak{}in(x=\textquotedbl{}y + 1\textquotedbl{})}}{Put a number or another formula in place of a letter, as a new formula.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-as-latex]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}latex}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}latex()}}{Show the formula as LaTeX, to paste into a paper; also gives the text back.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-limit-as]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}limit\_\allowbreak{}as}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}limit\_\allowbreak{}as(\textquotedbl{}x\textquotedbl{})}}{The limit: the value the formula comes close to as a letter goes to a value.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-taylor-series]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}taylor\_\allowbreak{}series}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}taylor\_\allowbreak{}series(around=0,\allowbreak{} up\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}power=4)}}{The formula as a sum of powers near one value (the Taylor series), as a new formula.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:undo]{\code{undo}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}undo()}}{Take the last change of the formula back.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-as-decimal]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}decimal}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}decimal(digits=50)}}{Show a formula without letters as a decimal with as many digits as you ask; also gives the text back.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:group-by-powers-of]{\code{group\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}powers\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}powers\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}x\textquotedbl{})}}{Multiply out, then gather the terms by powers of a letter (SymPy collect).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-partial-fractions]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}partial\_\allowbreak{}fractions}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}partial\_\allowbreak{}fractions()}}{Split a fraction into a sum of simple fractions (SymPy apart).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:as-sympy]{\code{as\_\allowbreak{}sympy}}}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}sympy()}}{The SymPy expression underneath, to carry on in SymPy itself.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:polynomial]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}polynomial}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}polynomial(\textquotedbl{}legendre\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} degree=3)}}{A named polynomial, as a formula.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-running-area]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}running\_\allowbreak{}area}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}running\_\allowbreak{}area(time\_\allowbreak{}step=60)}}{Turn readings into the area so far under their curve (a running integral).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-sum-of-series]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}sum\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}series}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}sum\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}series(\textquotedbl{}1/k**2\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} between=[1,\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}infinity\textquotedbl{}])}}{The sum of a formula for every whole number from one end to the other (a series).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-path-between-ends]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}path\_\allowbreak{}between\_\allowbreak{}ends}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}path\_\allowbreak{}between\_\allowbreak{}ends(\textquotedbl{}d2y/dx2 = -y\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} at\_\allowbreak{}ends=\{\textquotedbl{}y\textquotedbl{}: [0,\allowbreak{} 1]\},\allowbreak{} between=[0,\allowbreak{} 1])}}{Path between two ends.}
\glancegroup{Values between points}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-values-at]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}at(\textquotedbl{}population\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} at=\{\textquotedbl{}year\textquotedbl{}: [2001,\allowbreak{} 2003,\allowbreak{} 2011]\},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}country\textquotedbl{})}}{Estimate a column at places between the known points, by joining the dots.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:curve-through-points]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}curve\_\allowbreak{}through\_\allowbreak{}points}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}curve\_\allowbreak{}through\_\allowbreak{}points(x=[0,\allowbreak{} 5,\allowbreak{} 10],\allowbreak{} y=[8.\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{} 7.\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{} 6.\allowbreak{}2])}}{A smooth curve (a spline) through points.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-value-at]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}at(12)}}{The curve's value at a place, or at a list of places.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-slope-at]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}slope\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}slope\_\allowbreak{}at(12)}}{The slope of the curve at a place (\code{order=2}: the slope of the slope).}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-zeros]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}zeros}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}zeros()}}{Where the curve is 0 (or \code{where\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}is=}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-slope-curve]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}slope\_\allowbreak{}curve}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}slope\_\allowbreak{}curve()}}{A new curve: the slope of this one (\code{order=2}, the slope of the slope).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-area-curve]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}area\_\allowbreak{}curve}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}area\_\allowbreak{}curve()}}{A new curve: the area under this one from the first point.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-pieces]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}pieces}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}pieces()}}{The polynomial pieces of the curve, one row per piece.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-knots]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}knots}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}knots()}}{The knots of the spline and its numbers (coefficients).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:as-scipy]{\code{as\_\allowbreak{}scipy}}}{\code{curve.\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}scipy()}}{The SciPy object behind the curve, for SciPy's own words.}
\glancegroup{Distributions}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:distribution]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}distribution}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}distribution(\textquotedbl{}normal\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} average=50,\allowbreak{} standard\_\allowbreak{}deviation=10)}}{Make a distribution to ask chances, percentiles and random numbers of.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:compare-distributions-for]{\code{compare\_\allowbreak{}distributions\_\allowbreak{}for}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}compare\_\allowbreak{}distributions\_\allowbreak{}for(\textquotedbl{}sales\textquotedbl{})}}{Fit several distributions to a column and rank them by AIC (smaller is better).}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-cut-off]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}cut\_\allowbreak{}off}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}cut\_\allowbreak{}off(with\_\allowbreak{}chance\_\allowbreak{}above=0.\allowbreak{}025)}}{The value with this chance above it (or below it): critical values.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-middle-range]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}middle\_\allowbreak{}range}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}middle\_\allowbreak{}range(95)}}{The range that holds the middle percent of the distribution, as Numbers [low, high].}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-average]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}average}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}average()}}{The average (mean) of the distribution.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-median]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}median}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}median()}}{The median: half of the distribution is below it.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-standard-deviation]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}standard\_\allowbreak{}deviation}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}standard\_\allowbreak{}deviation()}}{The standard deviation of the distribution.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-variance]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}variance}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}variance()}}{The variance (the standard deviation squared).}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:make-random-numbers]{\code{make\_\allowbreak{}random\_\allowbreak{}numbers}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}random\_\allowbreak{}numbers(how\_\allowbreak{}many=100,\allowbreak{} with\_\allowbreak{}seed=1)}}{Numbers drawn at random from the distribution; the same seed gives the same numbers.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-parameters]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}parameters}}}{\code{distribution.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}parameters()}}{The parameters as a dictionary of plain names: \{\code{\textquotedbl{}average\textquotedbl{}}: 50, \code{\textquotedbl{}standard\_\allowbreak{}deviation\textquotedbl{}}: 10\}.}

\glancegroup{Models}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:explain]{\code{explain}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}explain(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} using=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}breakfast\textquotedbl{}])}}{Explain one column from several others with a model, and say how big each effect is.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-model-averages-of]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}model\_\allowbreak{}averages\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}model\_\allowbreak{}averages\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} for\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}in=\textquotedbl{}school\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} using=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}breakfast\textquotedbl{}])}}{The average the model gives for each group, once the other columns are allowed for.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:check-model-of]{\code{check\_\allowbreak{}model\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}check\_\allowbreak{}model\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} using=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}breakfast\textquotedbl{}])}}{Four pictures to check a model from \code{explain()}, as R \code{plot(lm(.\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{}))}.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:compare-models]{\code{compare\_\allowbreak{}models}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}compare\_\allowbreak{}models(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} using=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{}],\allowbreak{} against=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}breakfast\textquotedbl{}])}}{Does a bigger model explain the column better than a smaller one?}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-columns-that-predict]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}predict}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}that\_\allowbreak{}predict(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} using=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}sleep\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}breakfast\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}class\textquotedbl{}])}}{Choose the columns that predict a column, with the lasso and a penalty checked on left-out rows.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-group-levels-of]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}levels\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}group\_\allowbreak{}levels\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}marks\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} using=[\textquotedbl{}hours\textquotedbl{}],\allowbreak{} grouped\_\allowbreak{}by=\textquotedbl{}school\textquotedbl{})}}{Each group's own starting level (and own slope) in a mixed model.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-principal-components]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}principal\_\allowbreak{}components}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}principal\_\allowbreak{}components(how\_\allowbreak{}many=2)}}{Add principal components: a few new columns that hold most of the spread of many columns.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-nmds]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}nmds}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}nmds()}}{Draw the rows as points on a map where close points are similar rows (NMDS), in new columns.}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-diversity-columns]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}diversity\_\allowbreak{}columns}}}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}diversity\_\allowbreak{}columns(columns=[\textquotedbl{}blaTEM\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}blaCTXM\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}sul1\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}sul2\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}tetA\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}tetM\textquotedbl{}])}}{Add diversity columns: how many kinds each row holds, and how evenly (richness, Shannon, Simpson).}

(R forecast::accuracy)}

\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:change-angles-to]{\code{change\_\allowbreak{}angles\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}angles\_\allowbreak{}to(\textquotedbl{}degrees\textquotedbl{})}}{Change angles between radians and degrees (NumPy rad2deg, deg2rad).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-where-biggest]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}biggest}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}biggest()}}{Where the biggest number is, counting from 1 (NumPy argmax + 1).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-where-smallest]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}smallest}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}where\_\allowbreak{}smallest()}}{Where the smallest number is, counting from 1 (NumPy argmin + 1).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:make-pair-table-with]{\code{make\_\allowbreak{}pair\_\allowbreak{}table\_\allowbreak{}with}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}pair\_\allowbreak{}table\_\allowbreak{}with(depths,\allowbreak{} by\_\allowbreak{}subtracting=True)}}{A new table of every pair: each number with each of the other numbers (NumPy outer).}
\glancegroup{Blocks of numbers}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:number-block]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}number\_\allowbreak{}block}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}number\_\allowbreak{}block(of\_\allowbreak{}shape=(24,\allowbreak{} 8,\allowbreak{} 12),\allowbreak{} filled\_\allowbreak{}with=0,\allowbreak{} directions\_\allowbreak{}named=[\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}row\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}column\textquotedbl{}])}}{Make a block of numbers with any number of directions (NumPy's n-D array, PyTorch's tensor).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-shape]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}shape}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}shape()}}{The size of each direction, in words and as NumPy's shape: (24, 8, 12).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:count-directions]{\code{count\_\allowbreak{}directions}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}count\_\allowbreak{}directions()}}{How many directions the block has (NumPy ndim).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-direction-names]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}direction\_\allowbreak{}names}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}direction\_\allowbreak{}names()}}{The names of the directions, in order.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-number-at]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}number\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}number\_\allowbreak{}at(hour=1,\allowbreak{} row=2,\allowbreak{} column=3)}}{The number at one position in every direction, counting from 1.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-average]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}average}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}average(over=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{The average (mean) of the numbers; empty values are skipped.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-by-position-in]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} [1,\allowbreak{} 3])}}{Keep some positions along one direction, counting from 1, both ends included.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-by-position-in]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position\_\allowbreak{}in}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position\_\allowbreak{}in(\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} 24)}}{Remove some positions along one direction, counting from 1.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:keep-where]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}where}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}keep\_\allowbreak{}where(\textquotedbl{}east\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} is\_\allowbreak{}between=[2,\allowbreak{} 5])}}{Keep the part of a labelled direction whose labels pass (xarray sel).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-where]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}where}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}where(\textquotedbl{}north\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} is\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}of=[0,\allowbreak{} 1])}}{Remove the part of a labelled direction whose labels pass.}
\glancegroup{Blocks: shape and directions}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:change-shape-to]{\code{change\_\allowbreak{}shape\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}shape\_\allowbreak{}to(one\_\allowbreak{}row\_\allowbreak{}per=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{Give the numbers a new shape, row by row (NumPy reshape).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-direction]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}direction}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}direction(\textquotedbl{}plate\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} at\_\allowbreak{}position=1)}}{Add a direction of size 1, with a name (NumPy \code{expand\_\allowbreak{}dims}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:remove-directions-of-size-one]{\code{remove\_\allowbreak{}directions\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}size\_\allowbreak{}one}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}remove\_\allowbreak{}directions\_\allowbreak{}of\_\allowbreak{}size\_\allowbreak{}one()}}{Remove every direction that has size 1 (NumPy squeeze).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:swap-directions]{\code{swap\_\allowbreak{}directions}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}swap\_\allowbreak{}directions(\textquotedbl{}row\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}column\textquotedbl{})}}{Swap two directions (NumPy swapaxes).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:move-direction]{\code{move\_\allowbreak{}direction}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}move\_\allowbreak{}direction(\textquotedbl{}column\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} to\_\allowbreak{}position=1)}}{Move one direction to another place (NumPy moveaxis).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:rotate]{\code{rotate}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}rotate(by\_\allowbreak{}quarter\_\allowbreak{}turns=1)}}{Turn the block a quarter turn (or more) anticlockwise, as a picture (NumPy rot90).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:reverse]{\code{reverse}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}reverse(over=\textquotedbl{}row\textquotedbl{})}}{Turn the order round along a direction, or along every direction (NumPy flip).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:move-round-by]{\code{move\_\allowbreak{}round\_\allowbreak{}by}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}move\_\allowbreak{}round\_\allowbreak{}by(3,\allowbreak{} over=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{Move every number along a direction by some steps; the ones that fall off the end come round to the start (NumPy roll).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:insert-numbers]{\code{insert\_\allowbreak{}numbers}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}insert\_\allowbreak{}numbers(0,\allowbreak{} at\_\allowbreak{}position=2,\allowbreak{} over=\textquotedbl{}row\textquotedbl{})}}{Put new numbers in before a position along a direction (NumPy insert).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:repeat-each-number]{\code{repeat\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}number}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}repeat\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}number(3,\allowbreak{} over=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{Repeat each number along a direction: 1, 2 becomes 1, 1, 2, 2 (NumPy repeat).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:repeat-whole-block]{\code{repeat\_\allowbreak{}whole\_\allowbreak{}block}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}repeat\_\allowbreak{}whole\_\allowbreak{}block(2,\allowbreak{} over=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{Repeat the whole block along a direction: 1, 2 becomes 1, 2, 1, 2 (NumPy tile).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-numbers-from]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}from}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}from(other,\allowbreak{} over=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{Add another block's numbers at the end of one direction (NumPy concatenate).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:split-into-pieces]{\code{split\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}pieces}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}split\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}pieces(3,\allowbreak{} over=\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{Split the block into pieces along a direction; gives back a list of new blocks (NumPy \code{array\_\allowbreak{}split}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:split-into-one-block-per]{\code{split\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}block\_\allowbreak{}per}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}split\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}one\_\allowbreak{}block\_\allowbreak{}per(\textquotedbl{}hour\textquotedbl{})}}{One new block for each position of a direction, without that direction (NumPy unstack).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:stack-up]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}stack\_\allowbreak{}up}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}stack\_\allowbreak{}up([a,\allowbreak{} b,\allowbreak{} c],\allowbreak{} as\_\allowbreak{}new\_\allowbreak{}direction=\textquotedbl{}image\textquotedbl{})}}{Stack blocks of the same shape into one, along a new first direction (NumPy stack).}
\glancegroup{Blocks: stretching}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-how-it-lines-up-with]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}how\_\allowbreak{}it\_\allowbreak{}lines\_\allowbreak{}up\_\allowbreak{}with}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}how\_\allowbreak{}it\_\allowbreak{}lines\_\allowbreak{}up\_\allowbreak{}with(other)}}{Show how this block and another line up before combining them; nothing changes.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:stretch-to]{\code{stretch\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}stretch\_\allowbreak{}to((2,\allowbreak{} 24,\allowbreak{} 8,\allowbreak{} 12))}}{Stretch the block to a bigger shape by using its numbers again (NumPy \code{broadcast\_\allowbreak{}to}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:stretch-to-same-shape]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}stretch\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}same\_\allowbreak{}shape}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}stretch\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}same\_\allowbreak{}shape(a,\allowbreak{} b)}}{Two blocks stretched to one shape, as a sum would line them up; gives back two new blocks (NumPy \code{broadcast\_\allowbreak{}arrays}).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:hide-stretching-notes]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}hide\_\allowbreak{}stretching\_\allowbreak{}notes}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}hide\_\allowbreak{}stretching\_\allowbreak{}notes()}}{Stop the notes that say which numbers were used again when blocks are combined.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-stretching-notes]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}stretching\_\allowbreak{}notes}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}stretching\_\allowbreak{}notes()}}{Print the notes that say which numbers were used again when blocks are combined (the default).}
\glancegroup{Blocks: files}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-whats-inside]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}whats\_\allowbreak{}inside}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}whats\_\allowbreak{}inside(\textquotedbl{}sst\_\allowbreak{}monthly.\allowbreak{}nc\textquotedbl{})}}{Show what a file holds without loading its numbers: its variables, directions, sizes and units.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:save]{\code{save}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}save(\textquotedbl{}plate.\allowbreak{}csv\textquotedbl{})}}{Save the block; the end of the file name decides the type.}
\glancegroup{Blocks: labels, dates and places}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-labels-of]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}labels\_\allowbreak{}of}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}labels\_\allowbreak{}of(\textquotedbl{}time\textquotedbl{})}}{The labels of one direction (numbers, or a table of dates or text).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add-labels-to]{\code{add\_\allowbreak{}labels\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}labels\_\allowbreak{}to(\textquotedbl{}latitude\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} [60,\allowbreak{} 61,\allowbreak{} 62,\allowbreak{} 63])}}{Give a direction labels: one for each position, such as dates, depths or plate rows.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:find-values-at]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}at}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}find\_\allowbreak{}values\_\allowbreak{}at(latitude=60.\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{} longitude=2.\allowbreak{}5)}}{Values between the labels of a block, by straight lines between neighbours.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:get-numbers-nearest-to]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}nearest\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}get\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}nearest\_\allowbreak{}to(latitude=60.\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{} longitude=5.\allowbreak{}3)}}{The numbers at the labels nearest to the ones you give, such as the grid cell nearest a station.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-change-from-average]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}from\_\allowbreak{}average}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}from\_\allowbreak{}average(in\_\allowbreak{}each=\textquotedbl{}month\textquotedbl{})}}{Take the usual value away from each number, so the numbers become anomalies.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:smooth]{\code{smooth}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}smooth(over=[\textquotedbl{}latitude\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}longitude\textquotedbl{}],\allowbreak{} window=3)}}{Smooth a block along some directions: each number becomes a summary of its neighbours.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:change-size-to]{\code{change\_\allowbreak{}size\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{block.\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}size\_\allowbreak{}to(latitude=8,\allowbreak{} longitude=10)}}{Give directions a new size by filling in between the numbers (as resizing a picture).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:smooth]{\code{smooth}}}{\code{grid.\allowbreak{}smooth(window=3)}}{Smooth along some directions: each number becomes a summary of its neighbours, as blurring a picture.}
\glancegroup{Numbers: chances and random picks}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:make-random-picks]{\code{make\_\allowbreak{}random\_\allowbreak{}picks}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}random\_\allowbreak{}picks(how\_\allowbreak{}many=40,\allowbreak{} with\_\allowbreak{}seed=1)}}{Pick numbers at random from these ones; gives back new numbers.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:take-log-odds]{\code{take\_\allowbreak{}log\_\allowbreak{}odds}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}take\_\allowbreak{}log\_\allowbreak{}odds()}}{Turn chances (0 to 1) into log-odds, the logit: 0.8 becomes 1.386.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:turn-into-chances]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}chances}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}chances()}}{Turn log-odds back into chances from 0 to 1 (the logistic function): 1.386 becomes 0.8.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:count-ways-to-choose]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}count\_\allowbreak{}ways\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}choose}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}count\_\allowbreak{}ways\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}choose(3,\allowbreak{} out\_\allowbreak{}of=10)}}{How many ways there are to choose some things out of more, when the order does not matter.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:count-ways-to-order]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}count\_\allowbreak{}ways\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}order}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}count\_\allowbreak{}ways\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}order(3,\allowbreak{} out\_\allowbreak{}of=10)}}{How many ways there are to pick some things out of more in order (first, second ...).}
\glancegroup{Waves and systems}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:convolve-with]{\code{convolve\_\allowbreak{}with}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}convolve\_\allowbreak{}with([1,\allowbreak{} 2,\allowbreak{} 1])}}{Convolve the numbers with other numbers: each result is a sum of products as one list slides along.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:deconvolve-by]{\code{deconvolve\_\allowbreak{}by}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}deconvolve\_\allowbreak{}by([1,\allowbreak{} 2,\allowbreak{} 3])}}{Undo a convolution: the numbers divided by other numbers (polynomial division).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:change-time-step]{\code{change\_\allowbreak{}time\_\allowbreak{}step}}}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}change\_\allowbreak{}time\_\allowbreak{}step(to=0.\allowbreak{}01,\allowbreak{} time\_\allowbreak{}step=0.\allowbreak{}001)}}{Change the time between readings (resample): fewer readings (with a filter first) or more.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:make-wave]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}wave}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}wave(\textquotedbl{}sine\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} frequency=5,\allowbreak{} time\_\allowbreak{}step=0.\allowbreak{}01,\allowbreak{} how\_\allowbreak{}many=100)}}{Numbers that make a wave: a sine, square, sawtooth, chirp, pulse or impulse.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:make-window-shape]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}window\_\allowbreak{}shape}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}window\_\allowbreak{}shape(\textquotedbl{}hann\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} how\_\allowbreak{}many=64)}}{The weights of a window (taper), such as \code{\textquotedbl{}hann\textquotedbl{}}: high in the middle, low at the ends.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:system]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}system}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}system(\textquotedbl{}1 / (s**2 + 2*s + 5)\textquotedbl{})}}{A linear system (one input, one output) from its formula, coefficients, poles or matrices.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:step-response]{\code{step\_\allowbreak{}response}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}step\_\allowbreak{}response(until=10)}}{How the output answers an input that jumps from 0 to 1 and stays there.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:impulse-response]{\code{impulse\_\allowbreak{}response}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}impulse\_\allowbreak{}response(until=10)}}{How the output answers a short kick at time 0 (an impulse of size 1).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:response-to]{\code{response\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}response\_\allowbreak{}to(sdata.\allowbreak{}make\_\allowbreak{}wave(\textquotedbl{}square\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} frequency=0.\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{} time\_\allowbreak{}step=0.\allowbreak{}05,\allowbreak{} how\_\allowbreak{}many=400))}}{How the output answers any input you give: a simulation.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:frequency-response]{\code{frequency\_\allowbreak{}response}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}frequency\_\allowbreak{}response(between=[0.\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{} 100])}}{How much the system passes each frequency (gain) and how much it delays it (phase): the Bode data.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:poles]{\code{poles}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}poles()}}{The poles: the values of s (or z) where the bottom of the formula is 0. They set how it moves.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:zeros]{\code{zeros}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}zeros()}}{The zeros: the values of s (or z) where the top of the formula is 0 (inputs that do not get through).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:is-stable]{\code{is\_\allowbreak{}stable}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}is\_\allowbreak{}stable()}}{True when every response to a bounded input stays bounded (and settles).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:steady-gain]{\code{steady\_\allowbreak{}gain}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}steady\_\allowbreak{}gain()}}{Where the output settles for a constant input of 1 (the DC gain).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:in-steps]{\code{in\_\allowbreak{}steps}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}in\_\allowbreak{}steps(time\_\allowbreak{}step=0.\allowbreak{}1)}}{The same system in steps of \code{time\_\allowbreak{}step} (discrete time), for a computer that reads and acts in steps.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:then]{\code{then}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}then(sdata.\allowbreak{}system(\textquotedbl{}1 / s\textquotedbl{}))}}{This system, then another one after it (in series): the output of this one feeds the other.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:add]{\code{add}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}add(sdata.\allowbreak{}system(\textquotedbl{}1 / (s + 3)\textquotedbl{}))}}{This system and another side by side, their outputs added (in parallel): both get the same input.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:with-feedback]{\code{with\_\allowbreak{}feedback}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}with\_\allowbreak{}feedback()}}{The closed loop: the output is fed back (through a sensor, say) and taken from the input.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:table]{\code{table}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}table()}}{The system as numbers: \code{form=\textquotedbl{}transfer function\textquotedbl{}} (the coefficients of the top and the bottom, highest power first: power of s (power of z in steps), numerator, denominator), \code{\textquotedbl{}state space\textquotedbl{}} (the matrices A, B, C, D in controller form: matrix, row, column, value; SciPy tf2ss, as R control::tf2ss), \code{\textquotedbl{}poles and zeros\textquotedbl{}} (kind, real part, imaginary part; the last row is the gain), \code{\textquotedbl{}sections\textquotedbl{}} (second-order sections, one row each: numerator 1 to 3 and denominator 1 to 3, highest power first, as SciPy's sos rows; SciPy tf2sos, or the filter's own sections, as R gsignal::tf2sos) or \code{\textquotedbl{}partial fractions\textquotedbl{}} (the formula as a sum of residue / (s - pole) terms, plus any direct terms: SciPy residue, residuez in steps, as R gsignal::residue and residuez).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:chart]{\code{chart}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}chart()}}{A chart of the system: \code{show=\textquotedbl{}bode\textquotedbl{}} (gain in decibels and phase against frequency on a log scale, two panels; \code{\textquotedbl{}gain and phase\textquotedbl{}} is accepted), \code{\textquotedbl{}step\textquotedbl{}}, \code{\textquotedbl{}impulse\textquotedbl{}}, \code{\textquotedbl{}poles and zeros\textquotedbl{}} (x for poles, o for zeros; the unit circle for a system in steps; \code{\textquotedbl{}pole-zero\textquotedbl{}} is accepted) or \code{\textquotedbl{}nyquist\textquotedbl{}} (the frequency response as one curve; a feedback loop is stable when it stays clear of -1).}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:move-poles-to]{\code{move\_\allowbreak{}poles\_\allowbreak{}to}}}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}move\_\allowbreak{}poles\_\allowbreak{}to([-2,\allowbreak{} -3])}}{The system with its poles moved to new places by feeding back its inner state (pole placement).}
\glancegroup{Help}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-all-words]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}words}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}all\_\allowbreak{}words()}}{Print every simplydata word with a short example.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:help]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}help}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}help(\textquotedbl{}draw\_\allowbreak{}bars\textquotedbl{})}}{Explain one word: what it does, its options and an example you can run.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-lesson]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}lesson}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}lesson(1)}}{A lesson: an example to run, what each line does, and a task.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-packages-used]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}packages\_\allowbreak{}used}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}packages\_\allowbreak{}used()}}{List the packages that did the work behind your simplydata words, and how to cite them.}
\glancegroup{30 days of simplydata}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:start-30-days]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}start\_\allowbreak{}30\_\allowbreak{}days}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}start\_\allowbreak{}30\_\allowbreak{}days()}}{Start 30 days of simplydata: an hour a day of warm-up questions, lessons and tasks.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-today]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}today}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}today()}}{Show today's day of the 30 days of simplydata: warm-up questions, what to do and a task.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-day]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}day}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}day(5)}}{Show any day of the 30 days, without changing where you are.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:show-answers]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}answers}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}show\_\allowbreak{}answers(5)}}{The answers to a day's warm-up questions, and a worked answer to its task.}
\glanceword{\hyperref[dict:go-to-next-day]{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}go\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}next\_\allowbreak{}day}}}{\code{sdata.\allowbreak{}go\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}next\_\allowbreak{}day()}}{Go on to the next day now, without waiting for tomorrow.}
\end{glancetable}

\clearpage\section*{Word families}\label{families}\markboth{Word families}{Word families}
A family is learned once and used again and again: the start or the end of a word says what kind of thing it does. Each family below lists its words; each word is a link to its entry.
\begin{familytable}
\wordfamily{keep\_...}{keeps only some rows, columns or numbers; the rest go}{\hyperref[dict:keep-biggest-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}biggest\_\allowbreak{}rows}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-columns-by-position]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}columns\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-each-frequency-that]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}frequency\_\allowbreak{}that}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-each-number-that]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}each\_\allowbreak{}number\_\allowbreak{}that}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-first-numbers]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}first\_\allowbreak{}numbers}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-first-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}first\_\allowbreak{}rows}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-groups-where]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}groups\_\allowbreak{}where}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-last-numbers]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}numbers}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-last-rows]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}last\_\allowbreak{}rows}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-numbers-also-in]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}also\_\allowbreak{}in}}, \hyperref[dict:keep-numbers-by-position]{\code{keep\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}position}}, \section*{The words, A to Z}\label{words}
\begin{dictcolumns}
\letterhead{A}
\headword{add}{dict:add}
\sense{numbers}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}add()}}
\means{Add a number to every number (or add numbers one by one).}
\eg{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}add(5)}}
\field{Options}{\code{number=}}
\field{Underneath}{NumPy \code{array()}}
\field{See also}{\hyperref[dict:subtract]{\code{subtract}}, \hyperref[dict:times]{\code{times}}, \hyperref[dict:divide-by]{\code{divide\_\allowbreak{}by}}, \hyperref[dict:raise-to-power]{\code{raise\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}power}}, \hyperref[dict:take-square-root]{\code{take\_\allowbreak{}square\_\allowbreak{}root}}}
\where{Manual \manualpage{word:nums.add}{901}{section*.523}; lesson 13 (\manualpage{lesson:13}{86}{chapter.II.13})}
\sense{system}{\code{system.\allowbreak{}add()}}
\means{This system and another side by side, their outputs added (in parallel): both get the same input.}
\eg{\code{system.\allowbreak{}add(sdata.\allowbreak{}system(\textquotedbl{}1 / (s + 3)\textquotedbl{}))}}
\field{Options}{\code{other}}
\field{Underneath}{NumPy \code{polyadd()}, \code{polymul()}, \code{DataFrame()}}
\field{See also}{\hyperref[dict:then]{\code{then}}, \hyperref[dict:with-feedback]{\code{with\_\allowbreak{}feedback}}, \hyperref[dict:in-steps]{\code{in\_\allowbreak{}steps}}, \hyperref[dict:table]{\code{table}}, \hyperref[dict:steady-gain]{\code{steady\_\allowbreak{}gain}}}
\where{Manual \manualpage{word:system.add}{1077}{section*.727}}
\headword{add\_adjusted\_p\_value\_column}{dict:add-adjusted-p-value-column}
\sense{table}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}adjusted\_\allowbreak{}p\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}column()}}
\means{Adjust p-values for testing many things at once, in a new column.}
\eg{\code{table.\allowbreak{}add\_\allowbreak{}adjusted\_\allowbreak{}p\_\allowbreak{}value\_\allowbreak{}column(\textquotedbl{}p\_\allowbreak{}adjusted\textquotedbl{},\allowbreak{} test\_\allowbreak{}method=\textquotedbl{}benjamini-hochberg\textquotedbl{})}}
\field{Options}{\code{name=}, \code{from\_\allowbreak{}column=}, \code{test\_\allowbreak{}method=}}

\headword{undo}{dict:undo}
\sense{table}{\code{table.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\means{Take the last step back.}
\eg{\code{table.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\field{Options}{none}
\field{Underneath}{simplydata's own: it keeps the table as it was before each step and puts back the last one. In pandas or Polars you keep a copy yourself before a step (before = \code{df.\allowbreak{}copy()}) and go back to it.}
\field{See also}{\hyperref[dict:show-steps]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}steps}}, \hyperref[dict:start-again]{\code{start\_\allowbreak{}again}}, \hyperref[dict:save]{\code{save}}, \hyperref[dict:make-copy]{\code{make\_\allowbreak{}copy}}, \hyperref[dict:start-chart]{\code{start\_\allowbreak{}chart}}}
\where{Manual \manualpage{word:table.undo}{885}{section*.502}; lesson 10 (\manualpage{lesson:10}{66}{chapter.II.10})}
\sense{chart}{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\means{Take the last step back.}
\eg{\code{chart.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\field{Options}{none}
\field{Underneath}{simplydata's own: a chart is a list of steps drawn only when it is shown or saved, so undo takes the last word's steps and settings back before anything is drawn again. In matplotlib you would draw the chart again without that line.}
\field{See also}{\hyperref[dict:get-size]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}size}}, \hyperref[dict:as-matplotlib]{\code{as\_\allowbreak{}matplotlib}}, \hyperref[dict:get-scales-drawn]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}scales\_\allowbreak{}drawn}}, \hyperref[dict:get-text-drawn]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}text\_\allowbreak{}drawn}}, \hyperref[dict:get-numbers-drawn]{\code{get\_\allowbreak{}numbers\_\allowbreak{}drawn}}}
\where{Manual \manualpage{word:undo}{238}{section*.23}}
\sense{numbers}{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\means{Take the last step back.}
\eg{\code{numbers.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\field{Options}{none}
\field{Underneath}{simplydata's own: it keeps the numbers as they were before each step (up to 30 steps) and puts back the last one. With NumPy you keep a copy yourself before a step (before = \code{values.\allowbreak{}copy()}).}
\field{See also}{\hyperref[dict:show-steps]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}steps}}, \hyperref[dict:start-again]{\code{start\_\allowbreak{}again}}, \hyperref[dict:turn-into-table]{\code{turn\_\allowbreak{}into\_\allowbreak{}table}}, \hyperref[dict:start-chart]{\code{start\_\allowbreak{}chart}}, \hyperref[dict:save]{\code{save}}}
\where{Manual \manualpage{word:nums.undo}{1004}{section*.630}; lesson 13 (\manualpage{lesson:13}{86}{chapter.II.13})}
\sense{formula}{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\means{Take the last change of the formula back.}
\eg{\code{formula.\allowbreak{}undo()}}
\field{Options}{none}
\field{Underneath}{simplydata's own: a formula keeps its earlier forms. A SymPy expression never changes, so in SymPy you keep the old one in a variable yourself.}
\field{See also}{\hyperref[dict:find-taylor-series]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}taylor\_\allowbreak{}series}}, \hyperref[dict:show-as-decimal]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}decimal}}, \hyperref[dict:find-limit-as]{\code{find\_\allowbreak{}limit\_\allowbreak{}as}}, \hyperref[dict:group-by-powers-of]{\code{group\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}powers\_\allowbreak{}of}}, \hyperref[dict:show-as-latex]{\code{show\_\allowbreak{}as\_\allowbreak{}latex}}}
\where{Manual \manualpage{word:f.undo}{654}{section*.341}}

\clearpage\section*{Coming from another tool?}\label{other:names}
Names from pandas, Polars, R, NumPy, SciPy, matplotlib and seaborn, and everyday maths words. In simplydata they never run: \code{sdata.\allowbreak{}help(\textquotedbl{}groupby\textquotedbl{})} (or typing \code{table.\allowbreak{}groupby()}) points to the simplydata word. Here each name points to the word and the manual page that explains it. A name that is also a simplydata word is written with its object in front, such as \code{table.\allowbreak{}table}.
\begin{dictcolumns}
\letterhead{A}
